content_sections.heading: JMI Teaching Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: One Assistant Professor post in Machine Design/Production Design is reserved for the Multiple Disabilities category. One Assistant Professor post in Mathematics is reserved for the Orthopaedically Handicapped category.

rows.pay_range: Entry pay of Rs.1,31,400 with a special allowance of Rs.4,500 per month

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in the relevant field. First class or equivalent at either the Bachelor's or Master's degree level in the relevant branch. Minimum 10 years of teaching, research or industry experience. At least three years of experience in a position equivalent to Associate Professor. Required research publications and Ph.D. guidance experience as specified in the notification. Ph.D. in Environmental Studies, Environmental Science, Environmental Science and Management, Engineering or a relevant discipline. Minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. Total research score of 120. Minimum 10 years of relevant teaching or research experience with successful doctoral guidance. Ph.D. in the relevant field. First class or equivalent at either the Bachelor's or Master's level. At least six research publications in SCI, UGC or AICTE-approved journals. Minimum eight years of teaching, research or industry experience. At least two years of post-Ph.D. experience. Ph.D. in the concerned, allied or relevant discipline. Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade. Minimum eight years of teaching or research experience. At least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. Total research score of 75. Candidates must possess B.E., B.Tech. or B.S. and M.E., M.Tech., M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in the relevant branch, with first class or an equivalent grade in at least one of the degrees. Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant or allied subject. NET conducted by UGC or CSIR, or another UGC-accredited test such as SLET or SET. Candidates possessing an eligible Ph.D. may receive exemption from NET, SLET or SET according to UGC regulations. M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science and Management, Environmental Science and Engineering or a relevant discipline with at least 55% marks. NET, SLET or SET qualification, unless exempted under the applicable Ph.D. regulations. Candidates must possess a Ph.D. and first class at either the Bachelor's or Master's level with at least 16 years of teaching, research or industry experience. Alternatively, candidates with first class at the Bachelor's or Master's level and at least 20 years of experience may apply, subject to the experience conditions in the notification. Qualifications and experience will be calculated as of 6 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening or shortlisting of applications Interview Document verification The academic score will be used only to shortlist candidates for the interview. Final selection for all post categories will be based only on performance in the interview. Possessing the minimum qualification does not guarantee that a candidate will be called for an interview. The university may shortlist candidates based on higher qualifications, experience or other suitable criteria.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JMI Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the CU-Chayan recruitment portal . Complete the registration process using a valid email address and mobile number. Select the relevant Jamia Millia Islamia teaching post. Enter the required personal, educational, research and experience details. Upload self-attested copies of the required certificates and supporting documents. Pay the applicable application fee online. Review and submit the online application by 6 October 2026. Download and print the submitted application form. Attach self-attested copies of all documents claimed in the application. Serially number the supporting documents and mention the numbers against the relevant entries in the application. Send or submit the hard copy to the university so that it reaches by 16 October 2026. A separate application and applicable fee must be submitted for each post.

content_sections.heading: Hard Copy Submission Address
content_sections.text: Submission of the hard copy is mandatory. Candidates who submit only the online application may not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printed copy of the submitted online application Recent photograph Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets NET, SLET or SET certificate, where applicable Ph.D. degree and compliance certificate, where applicable Ph.D. course-work mark sheet, where applicable Experience certificates issued by the competent authority Research publication and research-score documents Caste or category certificate, where applicable Disability certificate, where applicable Foreign-degree equivalence certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities, where applicable Other documents claimed in the online application

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in JMI Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia has announced 46 teaching vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Principal and Head of Section posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 6 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is hard-copy submission compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must submit a hard copy of the application with self-attested documents by 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1,500 for UR and OBC candidates and Rs.750 for SC and ST candidates. PwD candidates are exempt from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed criteria. Final selection will be based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. However, candidates must submit a separate application and pay the applicable fee for each post.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the CU-Chayan portal at curec.samarth.ac.in.
